turns.canonical_user_turn: I'm new to AI content systems. Help me build a small fictional support assistant for a community library. I want to learn while we build it.
It helps library members find what to do when they cannot renew a book. We don't have an approved renewal policy yet.
Keep the wording calm and tell people what to do next. Save what we have so I can come back later.

limitations: Prepared inputs only; no model calls authorized
No learner or human judgment evidence
One prepared candidate per case; no repeated trials
